caption:
Inactive does not mean harmless. 🧹

Dashboard > Plugins: Deactivate, then Delete what you don't use.
Dashboard > Appearance > Themes: keep your active theme and delete the rest.
Back up first, then clean up.

scenes.text: Unused plugins are still on your site.
scenes.say: Unused plugins are still on your site. Time for a clean up.

scenes.fact: Old code stays on your server. Delete what you don't use.
scenes.say: Many people think inactive plugins cannot cause harm. But the old code stays on your server, and it can go out of date. Delete what you do not use.

scenes.title: Clean up plugins
scenes.say: First, back up your site. Then go to Plugins and deactivate the one you do not use. Then click Delete.

scenes.title: Keep only what you need
scenes.body: Keep your active theme. Delete the rest.
scenes.say: Do the same for themes. Keep your active theme, and delete the rest.
